description.value: Adela's is an award-winning bed and breakfast in West Kelowna, opened in 2017 by on-site hosts Jessie and Jay, who serve a hot breakfast daily from their own home. The property offers three guest rooms with private bathrooms and views of the surrounding mountains and valley, situated minutes from Okanagan wineries, hiking trails, and beaches. Cyclists will find it a welcoming and well-equipped base, with the hosts explicitly advertising secure storage for bikes alongside ski and luggage storage.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at adelasbnb.ca loaded successfully and is the primary evidence source. The /about page explicitly lists 'Secure storage for bikes, ski's, etc.' under Comfort & Security, confirming secure bike storage. Device charging is confirmed by multiple website mentions of 'Bedside USB charging ports & 110V outlets' in all rooms, and free Wi-Fi is prominently advertised throughout the site and corroborated by OSM tags internet_access=yes / internet_access:fee=no. Phone, address, and website all match between OSM and the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, licensed B&B with explicit secure bike storage, welcoming on-site hosts, and a strong amenity set; a clear and useful listing for touring cyclists in the West Kelowna / Okanagan corridor.
